title: Kata Module index
description: docs/02-engineering.md § 3 Content schema — the machine-checkable twin of the ModuleIndex TypeScript type (§ 2). Validated by scripts/validate-content.mjs against public/content/index.json, locally and in CI before the build. Ordinal contiguity and title verbatim-ness against docs/01-design.md § Curriculum are held by scripts/harness.test.ts, not expressible here.

categories.description: A Category is a titled group of Modules that share one practice language; every Module belongs to exactly one.

id.description: Category id exactly as committed in the content files — an opaque slug, e.g. 'software-design'.

ordinal.description: 1-based, contiguous, the order the Categories read in.

title.description: One line, shown above the Category's Modules.

description.description: One line, shown under the title — no newlines.

language.description: The one practice language every Module in this Category is written in.

id.description: Module id exactly as committed in the content files, unique app-wide: a short Category prefix and a 2-digit position — 'm01' in Software Design, 'ai01' in Agentic AI.

categoryId.description: The one Category this Module belongs to — must equal the id of an entry in categories.

ordinal.description: 1-based, contiguous within its Category — the reading order inside that Category.

description.description: One line, shown under the title — no newlines.
